title: Asymptotics of small eigenvalues on degenerations of Kähler manifolds
summary: We derive the exact asymptotic rates of the small eigenvalues of the Laplacian on one-parameter degenerations of compact Kähler manifolds equipped with induced background metrics. This generalizes a recent result of Dai and Yoshikawa to higher dimensions. To achieve this, we combine Li's uniform Skoda inequality with the method of auxiliary Monge-Ampère equations, introduced by Guo--Phong--Song--Sturm--Tong and adapted by Guedj--Tô. As an application, we establish estimates for degenerations of compact Kähler manifolds with reducible singular fibers.
